surfaces.label: Tool/Workpiece Collisions
surfaces.path: Backplot > Simulation > Settings > Collision Settings > Tool/Workpiece Collisions
surfaces.action: Controls tool-vs-workpiece collision detection: ON (all), Rapid Moves (only non-cutting), Cutting Moves (only cutting), OFF (disabled). Often handled better via Stock Compare.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Setting to OFF/Rapid removes expected cutting contact noise so only genuine gouges/rapids-into-stock surface as fails when proving a post.

surfaces.label: Simulation (Fast Version)
surfaces.action: Default simulation engine (Fast). Renders 3D material-removal simulation; selected via Editor Setup > Backplot > Simulation Window dropdown.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: The engine that actually executes the posted NC to validate motion/material removal. Choice of Fast vs Standard determines available features (enhanced quality is Fast-only).

surfaces.label: Simulation (Standard Version)
surfaces.action: Legacy simulation engine. Selected via Editor Setup > Backplot > Simulation Window dropdown.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Alternative sim engine for proving NC where Standard-only behavior is needed; enhanced-quality/refine-edges differ between engines so report fidelity depends on this choice.

surfaces.label: Machine Simulation
surfaces.action: Add-on enabling full machine kinematics simulation; unlocks collision-between-machine-components detection and limit reporting in the Simulation Report.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: The post-proof oracle for kinematics: with Machine Simulation on, the Simulation Report adds collision + axis-limit entries, proving the posted NC moves a real machine model without crashing or exceeding travel.

surfaces.label: Geometry Manager Tab
surfaces.action: Setup of elements (models/geometry) participating in the simulation scene.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Where stock/fixture/workpiece geometry for a proof run is configured, which gates collision and stock-compare results.

surfaces.label: Navigation Tab
surfaces.action: Overview/structure of the NC program for navigation during simulation.

surfaces.label: Simulation Tab
surfaces.action: Right-pane tab split into upper Simulation Report and lower simulation settings (collision, stock verification, simulation settings).
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Primary oracle pane: the Simulation Report lists all NC errors/collisions/limits the post may have produced; this is where pass/fail of a posted program is read.

surfaces.label: Variables Tab
surfaces.action: Tracks NC-code variables (macro/parameter values) as the simulation runs.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Lets you verify that a posted program's variable/parameter math evaluates as expected during proof (e.g. macro posts, parametric subprograms).

surfaces.label: Simulation Report
surfaces.path: Backplot > docking pane > Simulation > Simulation Report
surfaces.action: Lists all detected NC program errors with columns Line number, Type, Description, and ACTION (what CIMCO does until resolved, e.g. ignore command / highlight collision). Also lists collisions and limits when Machine Simulation add-on is active. Auto-updates on NC edits; clicking a row jumps to and highlights the offending NC line.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: THE post-proof oracle. After running a posted NC, this report enumerates every error/collision/limit; an empty report (errors+warnings clean) is the pass signal. Columns Line/Type/Description/Action are the machine-readable verdict. GUI-only — must be read via UIA (no documented export/file).

surfaces.label: Check collision and limit errors
surfaces.path: Backplot > Simulation > Simulation Report > Check collision and limit errors
surfaces.action: Button to manually rerun collision detection (CPU intensive, does not auto-run on each edit). Machine Simulation only.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Forces a fresh collision/limit pass over the posted NC on demand — the trigger that populates collision/limit rows in the report for proof verdicts on large programs.

surfaces.label: Show Errors
surfaces.path: Backplot > Simulation > Simulation Report > Show Errors
surfaces.action: Toggle to show error messages in the Simulation Report.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Must be enabled to read error verdicts when proving a post; disabling hides the fail signal.

surfaces.label: Show Warning
surfaces.path: Backplot > Simulation > Simulation Report > Show Warning
surfaces.action: Toggle to show warnings in the Simulation Report.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Enables warning-level findings (non-fatal post issues) in the proof report.

surfaces.label: Arc Type
surfaces.path: Backplot > Simulation > Settings > Simulation Settings > Arc Type
surfaces.action: How arc-center (I/J/K) is interpreted: As in G-code / Auto-detect / Relative to start (incremental) / Absolute arc center / Radius value.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Critical for proving arc output of a post: a mismatch between the post's arc-center convention and this setting produces wrong arcs in sim — set to 'As in G-code' to faithfully prove the post's chosen convention.

surfaces.label: Behavior When Limit is Reached
surfaces.path: Backplot > Simulation > Settings > Simulation Settings > Behavior When Limit is Reached
surfaces.action: Action when loop iteration limit hit: Ignore the limit / Break out of the loop / Prompt for decision.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Determines whether an excessive-loop posted program is silently ignored vs flagged during proof; 'Break out' keeps proof runs bounded for automation.

surfaces.label: Maximum Loop Iteration Limit
surfaces.path: Backplot > Simulation > Settings > Simulation Settings > Maximum Loop Iteration Limit
surfaces.action: How many loop iterations are allowed before triggering the Behavior-When-Limit-Reached action.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Guards against runaway loops in macro/parametric posted NC; bounds the proof run so an infinite-loop post fails deterministically.

surfaces.label: Radius compensation
surfaces.path: Backplot > Simulation > Settings > Simulation Settings > Radius compensation
surfaces.action: Enabled = radius (cutter) compensation NOT ignored; Disabled = radius compensation ignored during simulation.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Proves G41/G42 cutter-comp handling in the posted NC actually applies; if Disabled the sim ignores comp so comp errors stay hidden.

surfaces.label: Report errors
surfaces.path: Backplot > Simulation > Settings > Simulation Settings > Report errors
surfaces.action: Master toggle to enable/disable error checking that feeds the Simulation Report (referenced as 'Simulation Settings / Report errors').
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Must be ON for the Simulation Report to populate; turning it off disables the entire post-proof error oracle.

surfaces.label: Subprogram folder
surfaces.path: Backplot > Simulation > Settings > Simulation Settings > Subprogram folder
surfaces.action: Override folder to search for subprogram files (default is the main program's directory).
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Lets a blind proof of a posted program that calls subprograms (M98/M198) resolve the sub files from a known directory — set this to the post-output folder so subprogram calls don't fail.

surfaces.label: Quality zoom depth filter
surfaces.path: Backplot > Simulation > Settings > Stock Verification > Quality zoom depth filter
surfaces.action: On/Off — limits Zoom window / Zoom selection (Solid menu) to cut out only to a certain depth in the view direction.

surfaces.label: Rapid collisions
surfaces.path: Backplot > Simulation > Settings > Stock Verification > Rapid collisions
surfaces.action: On (highlighted red) / Off — check for collisions during rapid (G00) movement against the stock.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Catches the classic post fail: rapid moves plowing through stock. Red highlight is the visual/verdict signal during proof.

surfaces.label: Refine edges
surfaces.path: Backplot > Simulation > Settings > Stock Verification > Refine edges
surfaces.action: Yes/No — improves precision of edges in the stock model. Not available when the new enhancing algorithm is enabled.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Improves stock-model fidelity so stock-compare/gouge results during post proof are accurate at edges.

surfaces.label: Stopped spindle
surfaces.path: Backplot > Simulation > Settings > Stock Verification > Stopped spindle
surfaces.action: Behavior when spindle speed is 0: Cut (ignore, cut anyway), No cut (don't cut), Mark collision (cut but mark red).
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Proves the post issues spindle-on (M03/M04 + S) before cutting moves; 'Mark collision' surfaces any cut-with-stopped-spindle defect in the posted program.

surfaces.label: Tool colors
surfaces.path: Backplot > Simulation > Settings > Stock Verification > Tool colors
surfaces.action: On/Off — colorizes machined stock areas by the tool used.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Visual verification that each tool in the posted program removes the expected region (tool-assignment proof); GUI-visual only.

surfaces.label: Supported Controls
surfaces.action: Reference list of CNC controls supported by the simulation engines (subsection link in the Simulation overview).
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Tells which controller dialects can be proven; a post targeting an unsupported control cannot be faithfully simulated.

surfaces.label: Tool Manager
surfaces.action: Lists current loaded tools — Assemblies, Cutters, Holders (upper section) — used by the simulation.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Confirms the tool assemblies (cutter+holder) the posted NC references are loaded with correct geometry; wrong/empty assemblies invalidate collision proof.

surfaces.label: 3D Simulation Viewport
surfaces.action: Central real-time 3D view: material removal, tool/holder motion, machine axis movement (X/Y/Z A/B/C), collision visualization, stock colorization, cross-section; interactive orbit/pan/zoom, zoom-window, live updates during playback.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: The visual surface where collisions are highlighted and material removal is observed during a post proof; purely visual (UIA can read overlay state but verdicts come from the report/collision list).

surfaces.label: Simulation Window / Backplot Tab
surfaces.action: Top-level simulation workspace: NC program view (left), 3D simulation window (center, Fast or Standard engine), docking pane (right with Simulation/Navigation/Variables/Geometry Manager tabs).
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: The container in which a post's NC output is loaded, simulated, and proven. To prove a post you open the NC in this tab and run it; everything else (report, collisions) lives in its panes.

surfaces.label: Fanuc
surfaces.action: Fanuc vendor node. 3 dialects: Fanuc Milling, Fanuc Turning, Fanuc MX Turning.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: JM-fleet relevant: any JM machine on a Fanuc 30i/31i/32i control proves against these. The 30i/31i/32i family is the documented backplot dialect (see _m and _t leaves).

surfaces.label: Fanuc Milling (30i/31i/32i M)
surfaces.area: Simulation > Supported Controls > Fanuc > Fanuc Milling
surfaces.path: Simulation > Supported Controls > Fanuc > Fanuc Milling
surfaces.action: Fanuc 30i-31i-32i Milling dialect (as of CIMCO Edit 2025.01.14). G-codes: G0-G4, G5.1 AI contour/nano smoothing, G10 data input, G12.1/G13.1 polar interp, G15/G16 polar coord, G17-19 planes, G20/G21 inch/mm, G28/G30 ref return, G40-44 radius/length comp, G43.4/G43.5 TCP control type1/2, G49 cancel, G52/G53 coord, G53.1/G53.6 tool-axis dir control, G54/G54.1/G54.4 WCS+error comp, G55-G59, G65/G66/G66.1/G67 macro/modal, G68/G68.1/G68.2 3D coord conv + tilted plane, G69, G73-G89 canned, G90/G91, G92/G92.1 WCS preset, G94/G95 feed, G98/G99 retract, G103 toolbreak check, G120/G121/G130/G131 high-speed mode, G950 machining levels. M0-M6, M8/M9 coolant, M13/M14 spindle+coolant, M30, M31, M98/M99/M198 sub.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Proving table for JM Fanuc 30i/31i/32i mill posts. G43.4/G43.5 TCP control + G68.2 tilted working plane + G53.1 tool-axis-direction are the 5-axis differentiators; G5.1 AI-contour/nano-smoothing is the HSM differentiator. Prove emitted NC code-coverage against this exact set.

surfaces.label: Fanuc Turning (30i/31i/32i T)
surfaces.area: Simulation > Supported Controls > Fanuc > Fanuc Turning
surfaces.path: Simulation > Supported Controls > Fanuc > Fanuc Turning
surfaces.action: Fanuc 30i-31i-32i Turning dialect (as of CIMCO Edit 2025.01.14). DISTINCTIVE: documents three G-code systems side-by-side (System A / System B / System C) — same G-number maps to DIFFERENT meaning per system (e.g. G20 = inch in A/B but OD/ID turning cycle in C; G90 = OD/ID cycle in A but absolute in B/C). Covers G0-G4, G7.1/G107 cyl interp, G10, G12.1/G13.1 polar, G17-19, G28/G30, G32/G33 thread, G40-42 TNC, G50/G51 scaling+RPM-limit, G52-G59+G54.1, G68.2/G69.1 tilted plane, G70-G79 stock-removal/groove/thread cycles, G80-G89 drill/bore/tap, G90/G92/G94 turn/thread/face cycles, G96/G97 CSS, G98/G99 feed/retract, G112/G113 polar. M-set incl M10/M11 main spindle clamp, M83/M84/M85 mill-tool spindle, M203-M205 mill spindle, M210/M211 sub-spindle clamp, M329 rigid threading.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Proving table for JM Fanuc lathe posts. CRITICAL: must confirm the post's G-code SYSTEM (A/B/C) matches before proving — a System-A post simulated as System-C silently mis-reads G20/G70/G90/G94 (turning cycles vs inch/finish/absolute). This is a units/cycle-mismatch trap analogous to the inch-vs-mm scale error; verify the system selection first.

surfaces.label: Haas
surfaces.action: Haas vendor node. 4 selectable dialects: Haas NGC Turning, Haas NGC Milling, Haas VR Milling, Haas UMC Milling. NGC = Next Generation Control.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Highest JM-fleet relevance: JM's VMC-01..05 mills + Haas lathes run NGC. To prove a Haas mill post, select Haas NGC/VR/UMC Milling; for lathe posts select Haas NGC Turning. The dialect choice picks the G/M-code interpretation table the sim uses.

surfaces.label: Haas NGC Turning (96-8910J)
surfaces.area: Simulation > Supported Controls > Haas > Haas NGC Turning
surfaces.path: Simulation > Supported Controls > Haas > Haas NGC Turning
surfaces.action: Haas NGC Turning dialect (manual 96-8910J, as of CIMCO Edit 2025.01.14). G-codes: G0-G4, G17-19, G20/G21, G28/G30 home, G32 thread, G40-42 TNC, G50 RPM limit, G52-G59 + G110-G129 + G154 WCS, G65 macro, G70 finish, G71 OD/ID stock removal, G72 face stock removal, G73 irregular path, G74 face groove, G75 OD/ID groove, G76 multi-pass thread, G80-G89 canned, G90 OD/ID turn cycle, G92 thread cycle, G94 end-face cycle, G95 live-tool rigid tap face, G96/G97 CSS on/off, G98/G99 feed, G107 cyl interp, G112/G113 XY->XC, G184/G186 reverse tap, G187 accuracy, G195/G196 radial tap, G241-G249 radial drill/bore. M-codes incl M10/M11 chuck clamp, M12/M13 air gun, M19 orient, M23/M24 chamfer, M110/M111 secondary spindle chuck, M133/M134/M135 live tool, M154/M155 C-axis engage.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Proving table for JM Haas lathe posts (NGC turning). C-axis (M154/M155), live tooling (M133-135), and OD/ID turn/groove/thread cycles (G70-G76, G90/G92/G94) are the must-verify codes. Any emitted G/M outside this list will not simulate -> coverage-vs-this-set is the lathe-post proof.

surfaces.label: Haas NGC Milling (96-8210N)
surfaces.area: Simulation > Supported Controls > Haas > Haas NGC Milling
surfaces.path: Simulation > Supported Controls > Haas > Haas NGC Milling
surfaces.action: Haas NGC Milling dialect (manual 96-8210N, codes as of CIMCO Edit 2025.01.14). ~110 G-codes + ~35 M-codes the sim recognizes: G0-G4, G10 offsets, G12/G13 circular pocket, G17-19 planes, G20/G21 inch/mm, G28 home, G40-44/G49 cutter+length comp, G52-G59 + G110-G129 + G154 (P1-P99) WCS, G65 macro call, G68/G69 rotation, G70-G72 bolt-hole, G73-G89 canned drilling/boring/tap, G90/G91 abs/inc, G94/G95 feed mode, G98/G99 retract, G100/G101 mirror, G187 smoothness, G234 TCPC, G253/G254/G255 DWO, G268/G269 feature CS/tilt. M0-M13 spindle/coolant/4th-5th brake, M6/M16 toolchange, M19 orient, M30, M56/M69 relay, M73/M74 air blast, M83/M84 air gun, M88/M89 thru-spindle coolant, M96/M97/M98/M99 sub/jump, M109 user input.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Direct proving table for JM Haas mill posts (VMC-01..05, NGC). To prove a post: any G/M-code in the emitted NC that is NOT in this list will fail/ignore in sim -> byte-compare + code-coverage against this set is the proof. G187 smoothness, G234 TCPC, G268/G269 tilted-plane are the 4/5-axis indicators to verify for UMC-class work.

surfaces.label: Haas VR Milling (96-8300J)
surfaces.area: Simulation > Supported Controls > Haas > Haas VR Milling
surfaces.path: Simulation > Supported Controls > Haas > Haas VR Milling
surfaces.action: Haas VR (5-axis) Milling dialect (manual 96-8300J, as of CIMCO Edit 2025.01.14). Superset of NGC Milling adding 5-axis codes: G50/G51 scaling, G141 3D+ cutter comp, G143 5-axis tool-length comp+, G153 5-axis high-speed peck, G155 5-axis reverse tap, G161-G169 5-axis drill/spot/peck/tap/bore canned cycles, G174/G184 non-vertical rigid tap, G234 TCPC, G253 orient normal, G254/G255 DWO, G268/G269 feature CS/tilt. Same M-set as NGC mill.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Proving table for JM Haas 5-axis (VR-class) mill posts. The 5-axis-specific G143/G153/G161-G169/G234 (TCPC) codes are the differentiators to verify vs the 3-axis NGC list; a 5-axis post that emits these must be proven against THIS dialect (not plain NGC) or the sim mis-interprets tool-axis motion.

surfaces.label: Haas UMC Milling (96-8250E)
surfaces.area: Simulation > Supported Controls > Haas > Haas UMC Milling
surfaces.path: Simulation > Supported Controls > Haas > Haas UMC Milling
surfaces.action: Haas UMC (Universal Machining Center, 5-axis trunnion) Milling dialect (manual 96-8250E, as of CIMCO Edit 2025.01.14). NGC-mill superset adding G103 block-buffer limit, G187 smoothness, G234 TCPC, G254/G255 DWO, G268/G269 feature CS / tilted plane. Full G52-G129+G154 WCS, G73-G89 canned, standard Haas M-set incl 4th/5th brakes M10-M13.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Proving table for JM Haas UMC 5-axis posts. G234 TCPC + G254 DWO + G268/G269 feature-coordinate-system/tilted-plane are the UMC trunnion-kinematics codes a post MUST emit correctly; prove against THIS dialect for any UMC job so the sim resolves the B/C trunnion motion and reports limits/collisions accurately.

surfaces.label: Heidenhain
surfaces.action: Heidenhain vendor node. 3 dialects: Heidenhain ISO Milling, Heidenhain Milling with Turning, Heidenhain Milling (TNC conversational + ISO). (Per-dialect leaf pages NOT in this extraction set.)
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Not currently a JM-flagged control. Heidenhain has both a conversational (Klartext/TNC) and an ISO dialect — note CIMCO lists BOTH 'Heidenhain Milling' (conversational) and 'Heidenhain ISO Milling', so conversational-program backplot IS supported here (unlike Hurco). Leaf code-tables were not in this extraction (gap).

surfaces.label: Hurco
surfaces.action: Hurco vendor node. 1 dialect: Hurco Milling (WinMAX M / ISO-NC mode).
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: JM-fleet relevant: JM Hurco/WinMAX mills prove against this. Note CIMCO supports the WinMAX ISO/G-code mill mode for backplot — WinMAX conversational is NOT in this dialect table (gap for conversational-program proving).

surfaces.label: Hurco Milling (WinMAX M)
surfaces.area: Simulation > Supported Controls > Hurco > Hurco Milling
surfaces.path: Simulation > Supported Controls > Hurco > Hurco Milling
surfaces.action: Hurco WinMAX (M) Milling dialect (as of CIMCO Edit 2025.01.14). G-codes: G0-G4, G2.4/G3.4 helical, G5.1/G5.2/G5.3 surface finish/data smoothing/quality, G8.1/G8.2 ASR command buffer on/off, G10, G17-19, G20/G21, G28/G30, G40-44 comp, G43.4 5-axis linear interp, G49, G52/G53, G54/G54.1/G54.2/G55-G59 WCS, G65 macro, G68/G68.2/G68.3 3D conv/tilted plane/local-rotation transform, G69/G69.1 cancel transforms, G73-G89 canned (incl G84.2/G84.3 rigid tap), G90/G91, G92/G92.1, G94/G95 feed, G98/G99 retract. M0-M9 (M7 secondary coolant, M8 primary, M9 off both), M6 toolchange, M30, M31, M98/M99 sub, M126/M127 shortest-rotary-path on/off, M128/M129 tool-center-point management on/off, M140 tool-axis retraction.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Proving table for JM Hurco WinMAX mill posts (ISO/G-code mode). G43.4 5-axis linear interp + G68/G68.2/G68.3 transform planes + M128/M129 TCP management + M126/M127 shortest-rotary-path are the multi-axis differentiators; G5.1-G5.3 surface-finish + G8.1/G8.2 ASR buffer are HSM indicators. Prove emitted NC coverage against THIS set — and note WinMAX conversational programs cannot be proven here (only ISO-NC).

surfaces.label: Supported Controls
surfaces.action: Top-level index of every controller VENDOR whose dialect the CIMCO backplotter/simulator can interpret natively for backplot+sim. 17 vendors: Brother, Centroid, Delectron, Fagor, Fanuc, Flexium, Haas, Heidenhain, Hurco, Mazak, Mitsubishi, NumeriPath, OSAI, Okuma, Roeders, Siemens (+ subsections).
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Master gate for post-proving: the simulator can only backplot/collision-check a post's NC if the target controller's dialect is in this set. Picking the right vendor->dialect is step 0 of proving a JM-fleet post (Haas/Fanuc/Okuma/Mitsubishi/Hurco all present).

surfaces.label: Mazak
surfaces.action: Mazak vendor node. 5 dialects: Mazak Turning, Mazak Integrex, Mazak Milling, Mazak SmoothAi Milling, Mazak SmoothAi Milling with Turning. (Per-dialect G/M leaf pages NOT in this extraction set — only the vendor index was read.)
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Not in current JM fleet flag-set but high-value: Mazak Integrex (mill-turn) + SmoothAi mill+turn dialects mean CIMCO can backplot multi-tasking mill-turn — relevant if JM acquires Mazak or proves a Mazatrol-to-ISO post. Per-dialect code tables would need a follow-up extraction.

surfaces.label: Mitsubishi
surfaces.action: Mitsubishi vendor node. 2 dialects: Mitsubishi Turning (M700/M70 L), Mitsubishi Milling (M800/M80 MC).
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: JM-fleet relevant: JM machines on Mitsubishi M700/M800 controls prove against these. Mitsubishi dialect closely tracks Fanuc but has its own decimal-subcode forms (G37.1, G43.4, G53.1, G76.1/G76.2) to verify.

surfaces.label: Mitsubishi Milling (M800/M80 MC)
surfaces.area: Simulation > Supported Controls > Mitsubishi > Mitsubishi Milling
surfaces.path: Simulation > Supported Controls > Mitsubishi > Mitsubishi Milling
surfaces.action: Mitsubishi M800/M80 (MC) Milling dialect (as of CIMCO Edit 2025.01.14). G-codes: G0-G4, G10 data input, G17-19 planes, G20/G21 inch/metric, G28/G30 ref return, G34/G35/G36/G37.1 special fixed cycles (bolt-circle/line/arc/grid), G40-44 radius+length comp, G43.4 TCP control type1, G49 cancel (length+TCP), G52/G53 coord, G53.1 tool-axis dir, G54/G54.1/G55-G59 WCS, G65 macro, G68.2 inclined-surface, G69, G73-G89 fixed cycles, G90/G91, G92/G92.1, G94/G95 feed, G98/G99 retract. M0-M9 stop/spindle/coolant, M6 toolchange, M30, M98/M99/M198 sub (M198 from SD card).
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Proving table for JM Mitsubishi mill posts. G43.4 TCP control + G68.2 inclined-surface + G53.1 tool-axis-dir are the 5-axis differentiators; G34-G37.1 special fixed cycles (bolt/line/arc/grid) are Mitsubishi-distinct. Prove emitted code-coverage against this set.

surfaces.label: Mitsubishi Turning (M700/M70 L)
surfaces.area: Simulation > Supported Controls > Mitsubishi > Mitsubishi Turning
surfaces.path: Simulation > Supported Controls > Mitsubishi > Mitsubishi Turning
surfaces.action: Mitsubishi M700/M70 (L) Turning dialect (as of CIMCO Edit 2025.01.14). G-codes: G0-G4, G7.1/G107 cyl interp, G8 high-speed machining, G10, G17-19, G20/G21, G28/G30, G40-42 TNC, G50 RPM limit, G52/G53 coord, G54-G59 WCS, G65 macro, G70 finish, G71 longitudinal rough, G72 face rough, G73 formed-material rough, G74 face cut-off, G75 longitudinal cut-off, G76/G76.1/G76.2 compound + 2-part synchronous thread cycles, G80-G89 drill/bore/tap, G96/G97 CSS. M-codes incl M13/M14 spindle+coolant, M23/M24/M25 2nd-spindle CW/CCW/stop, M30, M98/M99/M198 sub.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Proving table for JM Mitsubishi lathe posts. G76.1/G76.2 (2-part synchronous thread cutting) + M23/M24/M25 (2nd spindle) are the multi-spindle/sync indicators; G71-G75 rough/cut-off cycles are the stock-removal proof targets. Verify code-coverage against this dialect.

surfaces.label: Okuma
surfaces.action: Okuma vendor node. 2 dialects: Okuma Turning, Okuma Milling (OSP-200 10th gen).
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: JM-fleet relevant: JM Okuma OSP-200 machines prove against these. Okuma G-code semantics differ markedly from Fanuc (e.g. G50 zero-shift+RPM, LAP G80-G87 contour/turning) so the dialect MUST be Okuma, not a Fanuc proxy.

surfaces.label: Okuma Milling (OSP-200M 10th)
surfaces.area: Simulation > Supported Controls > Okuma > Okuma Milling
surfaces.path: Simulation > Supported Controls > Okuma > Okuma Milling
surfaces.action: Okuma OSP-200M (10th gen) Milling dialect (as of CIMCO Edit 2025.01.14). G-codes: G0-G4, G10/G11 coord shift, G15/G16 WCS modal/one-shot, G17/G18/G19 planes, G20/G21 inch/metric confirm, G30 home, G40-42 cutter radius comp, G53 length-offset cancel, G56 Z length offset, G71 return level, G73-G89 fixed cycles (drill/tap/bore/back-bore/multi-step), G90/G91 abs/inc, G94/G95 feed, G131 high-speed contour, G169/G170 length offset at cutting edge, G272-G284 deep-hole tap/drill synchronized cycles. M-codes incl M15/M16 4th-axis rotation, M52/M53/M54 return levels, M115/M116 5th-axis rotation.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Proving table for JM Okuma OSP mill posts. Okuma-specific G15/G16 WCS selection, G131 high-speed contour, and the G272-G284 synchronized-tapping family are the must-verify codes; M15/M16 (4th) + M115/M116 (5th) are the rotary-axis indicators. Prove coverage against THIS Okuma set, never against a Fanuc table.

surfaces.label: Okuma Turning (OSP-200L 10th)
surfaces.area: Simulation > Supported Controls > Okuma > Okuma Turning
surfaces.path: Simulation > Supported Controls > Okuma > Okuma Turning
surfaces.action: Okuma OSP-200L (10th gen) Turning dialect (as of CIMCO Edit 2025.01.14). G-codes: G0-G4, G15/G16 WCS, G17-19 planes, G20 home, G31-G35 fixed/non-fixed thread cutting, G40-42 cutter comp, G50 zero-shift+RPM limit, G69/G70 taper cycles, G71/G72 thread cutting cycle, G73/G74 grooving, G75 chamfer, G76 rounding, G77/G78 tapping, G80-G87 LAP contour/blank/bar-turning/copy/finish cycles, G90/G91, G94/G95 feed, G96/G97 CSS, G101-G103 contour-gen interp, G136/G137/G138 coord conversion+Y-axis, G178/G179 tap, G180-G189 fixed drill/bore/tap/thread cycles. M-codes incl M12/M13 M-tool spindle, M19 orient, M22/M23 chamfer, M83/M84 chuck clamp, M88/M89 air blower, M248/M249 sub-spindle chuck.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Proving table for JM Okuma OSP lathe posts. The LAP contour-definition family (G80-G87) + G50 zero-shift/RPM + G71/G72 compound-thread cycles are uniquely Okuma; M-tool (M12/M13) + sub-spindle chuck (M248/M249) are the multi-spindle/live-tool indicators. Prove against THIS dialect — LAP cycles are unrecognizable under any Fanuc-system proxy.

surfaces.label: Siemens
surfaces.action: Siemens vendor node. 2 dialects: Siemens Turning, Siemens Milling (SINUMERIK 840D-class). (Per-dialect G/M leaf pages NOT in this extraction set.)
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Not currently a JM-flagged control, but Siemens SINUMERIK uses G-code + CYCLE8xx/spline (ShopMill/ShopTurn) — proving a Siemens post requires this dialect; the leaf code-tables were not in this extraction (gap).

surfaces.label: Make Tool List
surfaces.action: Generates the tool list (incl. advanced/HTML template output) for the open NC file using the selected File Type's Tool List config; output appears in a new file tab and can be saved (e.g. .html).
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: This is the executable proving step: run Make Tool List on the post-output NC, then byte/field-compare the generated list against the golden tool list to prove the post emitted every tool change + description correctly. Output is a new editor tab (readable via file once saved).

surfaces.label: Close Tool Manager (X)
surfaces.action: Closes the Tool Manager; the running simulation updates to reflect changes. Unsaved changes are lost if the sim is ended without saving.

surfaces.label: Copy (between library and current list)
surfaces.action: Copies a tool up (current list -> library) or down (library -> current list); arrow direction toggles based on which list has the selection.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Lets you load a known-good tool from a library into the current scanned NC tool list before sim, so collision/geometry proving uses the intended tool rather than CIMCO's scan guess.

surfaces.label: Create Item dialog
surfaces.path: Tool Manager > (Add Item / Create Library) > Create Item
surfaces.action: Dynamic dialog for creating an assembly, cutter, holder, component or library; layout changes by item type and offers subgroups to narrow down the exact item before configuration.

surfaces.label: Tools in current NC program (Assemblies / Cutters / Holders tabs)
surfaces.path: Tool Manager > Tools in current NC program > [Assemblies|Cutters|Holders]
surfaces.action: Lists the assemblies, cutters and holders that CIMCO identified by scanning the loaded NC program; switch tabs to view each category. Click=select, double-click=edit, right-click=context menu.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: This list is the proof that the post-processor emitted recognizable tool-change codes — if the expected tools do not appear here, the post's tool trigger output is wrong. Read via UIA to assert tool count/IDs match the golden program.

surfaces.label: Add Item to Current Document
surfaces.path: Tool Manager > Tools in current NC program > Add Item to Current Document
surfaces.action: Launches the Create Item dialog to add a tool assembly or individual component (holder, drill, mill, insert, probe) into the current NC program's tool list.

surfaces.label: Current-list item right-click menu
surfaces.area: Tool Manager > upper area (current NC tools)
surfaces.path: Tool Manager > Tools in current NC program > right-click item
surfaces.action: Per-item context menu over a scanned tool: Edit, Duplicate, Delete, set Item id, view Item number, set Description.

surfaces.label: Delete Associated Components
surfaces.path: Tool Manager > Tools in current NC program > Delete Associated Components
surfaces.action: Option that, when enabled, also deletes the associated holder and cutter when an assembly is deleted.

surfaces.label: Hide Preview
surfaces.path: Tool Manager > Tools in current NC program > Hide Preview
surfaces.action: Toggles visibility of the right-side tool preview section.

surfaces.label: Library item right-click menu
surfaces.path: Tool Manager > Tool Libraries > right-click item
surfaces.action: Per-item context menu over a library tool: Edit, Duplicate, Delete, set Item id, view Item number, set Description.

surfaces.label: Create Library or Add Item
surfaces.path: Tool Manager > Tool Libraries > Create Library / Add Item
surfaces.action: Creates a new tool library or adds an assembly/holder/drill/mill/insert/probe to a library via the Create Item dialog.

surfaces.label: Tool error indicator (red triangle)
surfaces.action: A red triangle on the right of a list row signals a detected error in that item; hover shows the error description.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Direct proving signal: a red error triangle on a scanned tool means the geometry/config CIMCO derived from the NC is invalid — read the hover text via UIA to surface post-induced tool errors.

surfaces.label: Libraries list
surfaces.action: Lists predefined and custom tool libraries; click to select, right-click to rename/delete, hover to see filesystem path. Libraries are stored under /ToolLibs in the CIMCO install folder.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: A proven post often references a known tool library; libraries are on-disk files under <install>/ToolLibs and can be read/written directly (file channel) to pre-load the exact tool set a golden NC expects before sim, bypassing the GUI.

surfaces.label: Library content tabs (Assemblies / Cutters / Holders)
surfaces.action: Lists the assemblies/cutters/holders inside the currently selected library; click=select, double-click=edit, right-click=context menu.

surfaces.label: Tool Libraries visibility options
surfaces.path: Tool Manager > Tool Libraries > visibility menu
surfaces.action: Hides either the entire Tool Libraries section or just the library list on the left.

surfaces.label: Tool Setup (open Tool Manager)
surfaces.action: Opens the Tool Manager window for creating/editing tools and managing tool libraries; only reachable while a Backplot/Machine-Simulation session is active.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: To prove a post, you must verify the post's tool-change blocks resolve to real tools with correct geometry; opening Tool Manager exposes the tools CIMCO scanned out of the NC, so geometry/collision proving starts here.

surfaces.label: Toggle Dark Mode Rendering
surfaces.path: Tool Manager > Tool Preview > Toggle Dark Mode Rendering
surfaces.action: Toggles dark/light rendering of the tool preview pane.

surfaces.label: Replace (preserve tool number)
surfaces.action: Replaces a tool in the current list with one from the library (or vice-versa) while preserving the original tool number; arrow direction toggles on selection.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Swaps in a verified-geometry tool while keeping the post-emitted tool number, so the sim proves the NC's tool numbering against correct physical tool geometry.

surfaces.label: Save Setup (persist tool config)
surfaces.action: Persists the current NC program's tool configuration to a .setup file in the same folder as the NC program (or, depending on Scanning config, writes the config directly into the NC program). Setup/tool data are saved via Scanning Commands auto-loaded at sim start.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: The .setup sidecar file is the durable record of proven tool geometry for a given NC; writing/reading it via the file channel lets PRISM pre-stage exact tools for repeatable golden-vs-actual sim proving without GUI clicks.

surfaces.label: Machine Type (selector)
surfaces.action: Dropdown to select which configured machine to send to / receive from. Selects the active machine config for the next transfer.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Selects the target machine for drip-feeding the proven NC; choosing the right machine config (port/baud/protocol) is part of proving the post lands on the correct controller.

surfaces.label: Status
surfaces.action: Shows the Transmit dialog again if it was hidden. Disabled for FTP machines.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Re-surfaces the live transmit status dialog so an agent can read transfer progress/signals during a drip-feed ship.

surfaces.label: Receive Status
surfaces.action: Live serial receive dialog; mirror of Transmit Status (signals, info, progress, terminal) for capturing NC from the CNC.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Receiving a program back from the control allows round-trip byte-compare (send proven NC, read it back) to prove transfer integrity.

surfaces.label: Transmit Status
surfaces.action: Live serial transmission dialog: RS-232-C signal lamps, transmission info (machine, filename, bytes sent), progress bar, terminal window of NC being sent.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: This is THE drip-feed observation surface: bytes-sent + progress + terminal echo prove the verified NC actually streamed to the machine. Reading signal lamps + completion is the ship-verification step.

surfaces.label: Hide
surfaces.action: Hides the transmit dialog (re-show via Machine > Status).

surfaces.label: Stop (transmission)
surfaces.action: Stops the in-progress transmission; prompts for confirmation.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Abort control during a drip-feed — needed to halt a ship if collision/limit/error detection flags a bad post before completion.

surfaces.label: Terminal Window
surfaces.action: Shows the NC program being transmitted in plain text; toggles with Hide Terminal; options to Scroll and Show CR/LF.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Plain-text echo of the streamed NC lets an agent byte/line-compare what the machine actually received against the golden post output — direct ship-fidelity proof.

surfaces.label: DNC Setup
surfaces.action: Opens the DNC Setup dialog (separate from Editor Setup; not reachable from Editor Setup). Configures serial + FTP machine configurations.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: Gateway to configuring the machine/port that the proven NC will be drip-fed to; must be set correctly before any real ship.

surfaces.label: Transmission
surfaces.action: Top-level program tab that exposes the DNC transfer surface (send/receive NC programs to/from CNC via serial or FTP). Requires DNC license.
surfaces.postProvingRelevance: This is the entry point to the SHIP step — after a post processor's NC output is verified, this tab is how you drip-feed the verified NC to a machine. Proving end-to-end requires reaching this tab.
